name: processing-upgrades
prompt: Penny Empire production source atlas. Approved reference gallery STYLE only; no checkerboard or labels. Four isolated buildings, clean 2x2 grid, fully transparent background and generous gutters. Top row flour mill tier2 and tier3. Bottom row dairy tier2 and tier3. Preserve redbrick/slate Victorian mill and cream-brick dairy with steel tanks from reference. Same reserved 3x2 plot and same silhouette height limits as originals. Tier2 improved industrial doors, modern enclosed machinery annex, upgraded silo/pipes within original footprint. Tier3 well-maintained commercial leader, sophisticated machinery, larger capacity tanks occupying SAME reserved plot, refined stone details and small gold quality emblem, NO TEXT. Mill still three storeys, dairy still two. Strict orthographic 2:1 isometric, upper-left warm light, parallel axes, same terracotta ochre slate muted teal pixel palette and crisp pixel density as reference. No ground slabs, people, vehicles, UI, labels, shadows outside silhouette or background glow. Blank sign panels for dynamic names. Four complete separate building sprites not scenes. Source canvas 1536x1536. Do not redesign base architecture or expand occupied land.

name: courier-walk
prompt: Penny Empire character WALK CYCLE SOURCE atlas. Reference STYLE only. Exactly 4 columns x4 rows transparent sheet. One courier wearing rust jacket navy cap dark trousers carrying brown parcel, same person proportions and same outfit every frame. Each row is a direction: row1 SW, row2 SE, row3 NE, row4 NW. Columns are four distinct walk phases: left foot forward, passing pose, right foot forward, passing pose. All sixteen frames same character size and same foot baseline inside equal cells, no drifting scale. Orthographic isometric camera from above matching 2:1 city; crisp chunky pixel clusters readable at existing 40px logical character height; upper-left lighting. Real transparent alpha, no ground, shadow, UI, labels, frame borders or checkerboard. Wide empty gutters. Source1024x1024. Arms carrying package steady, legs move naturally. This is sprite motion, not sixteen different characters. Avoid blur.
